rulings.target: outcomes[oxygenation pao2 fio2 torr continuous @crossover condition]
rulings.reason: Six conditions applied to the same 14 patients: the schema's crossover_condition (arm label carries the meaning) fits; repeated_measures is for a trajectory over time, so DeepSeek's timepoint type is wrong. rulings.evidence: p. 4 (303), Table 2 (page image); p. 4 Results; p. 7 Fig. 4 legend
